title: Entropy seed drift caused variant flip-flop & thundering reroutes
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Summary: During a sustained capacity surge on 2026-03-01 we observed a rapid increase in cross-region reroutes and a simultaneous increase in tail latency. Root cause analysis shows an entropy-seed drift between router replicas combined with a race in the variant selection cache that produced non-deterministic variant choices across replicas. The mismatch manifested as repeated variant flip-flops for long-lived sessions which triggered automated fallback and retry paths, amplifying traffic across regions (thundering reroutes) and burning Dedicated capacity.
comments: 2026-03-01 09:12 - Alerting triggered: multi-region latency spike and >20% increase in fallback rate. Pager duty: oncall team handled immediate mitigation.

2026-03-01 09:37 - Mitigation applied: global routing backoff configured, priority-based circuit breaker lowered for non-critical tiers. This reduced immediate customer errors but increased p99 latency for a subset of customers.

2026-03-02 11:00 - Initial RCA meeting: identified inconsistent PRNG seed/versioning across router replicas as likely cause; discovered variant-resolution cache uses per-replica nonce in tie-breaker logic.

2026-03-03 15:20 - Telemetry deep-dive: correlated seed divergence with a rolling deploy of router config (config-service v2.4) that included a subtle refactor of RNG initialization timing. See logs and histograms: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/routing/entropy-drift-2026-03 (internal)

2026-03-05 14:40 - Dev note: reproduced locally by running two router replicas with interleaved config reloads; variant cache collision observed at sequence numbers > 1M. Repro repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/tree/eng/entropy-driftsim (PR forthcoming)
2026-03-06 09:00 - Interim change: added cross-replica seed health check and alert (low confidence) — alert: SEED_DESYNC_HIGH. Action reduced duration of incident windows.

2026-03-08 16:30 - Review feedback from SRE and Research: propose deterministic RNG initialization, remove per-replica nonce from tie-breaker, and add variant-selection deterministic hashing with explicit region affinity policy.
2026-03-09 11:15 - Design review: agreed on three-lane plan (short-term guardrails, medium-term fixes in routing core, long-term observability and chaos tests). Assigned action items and owners.
2026-03-10 08:45 - Engineering PRs opened: GH-Redwood/routing#2314 (seed-sync), GH-Redwood/routing#2316 (tie-breaker removal). Links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pulls (internal)
2026-03-10 12:00 - Customer comms: Customer Success notified top 5 impacted customers; follow-up scheduled. Status updates posted to incident channel.
2026-03-10 16:00 - QA: test plan for deterministic seed rollout and canary described in ticket ENG-625020. Adding integration test for variant stability under rolling config reloads.
action_items: (Short-term) Add seed-consistency and tie-breaker telemetry: implement metric SEED_DESYNC_RATE and dashboard; owner: Priya Nair; due: 2026-03-17; ticket: ENG-625000
(Short-term) Emergency guardrail: disable per-replica nonce tie-breaker and enable deterministic fallback sharding; owner: Carlos Mendes; due: 2026-03-12; ticket: ENG-624995

(Medium-term) Deterministic RNG initialization: ensure config-service seeds replicas from a monotonically-increasing cluster seed during deploys; owner: Michael O'Leary; due: 2026-03-31; ticket: ENG-625010

(Medium-term) Variant selection overhaul: replace ad-hoc tie-breaker with stable hashing + explicit affinity rules and add atomic cache update path; owner: Hanna Li; due: 2026-04-07; ticket: ENG-625030

(Medium-term) Canary plan & rollout policy: add a canary that enforces seed-sync check before traffic ramp; SRE to own traffic ramp runbook; owner: SRE Team (lead: Diego Alvarez); due: 2026-03-24; ticket: ENG-625020
(Long-term) Chaos testing & regression suite: add targeted chaos test for seed drift and rolling deploys to CI; owner: Research/QA (lead: Samir Patel); due: 2026-05-01; ticket: ENG-625100

(Long-term) Post-incident review & docs: update runbook with explicit detection steps, mitigation commands, and postmortem summary; owner: Aisha Khan; due: 2026-03-18; docs: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/ENG/Routing-Runbook (internal)
(Follow-up) Customer impact analysis: detailed token/latency/cost impact per customer and recommended credits; owner: Customer Success (lead: Maria Chen); due: 2026-03-20
